messages:
maya: Hey — I addressed the review comments from yesterday and rolled the tiny fixes into one commit. Updated the changelog and added a short note about the retry/backoff semantics. PTAL when you have a minute. If there are no blockers I can squash+merge and grab the canary slot tonight (17:30 PT).

alex: Quick q — for the retry change, did you keep the old behaviour where 0ms means no backoff? I want to avoid changing client-facing semantics.

maya: Good catch. I preserved 0ms as 'no backoff' and added an explicit guard. Diff excerpt:```diff
- backoff = max(1, base * attempt)
+ # preserve explicit 0 to mean "no backoff"
+ if config.no_backoff_ms == 0:
+     backoff = 0
+ else:
+     backoff = max(1, base * attempt)
```

sam: lgtm from perf — ran the staging perf job, batching/throughput looks identical. :thumbsup:

lee: left one tiny nit about a log level (info -> debug) but not blocking.

maya: addressed the log-level nit and added a short comment explaining why debug is ok here. Also re-enabled the screenshot tests that were flaky; CI job fixed a timing issue.

ci-bot: CI — all checks passed: unit, integration, e2e, screenshots ✅

maya: Thanks! Can I get a second approver? This repo needs two approvers before merge. @alex @lee can you approve in GH if it looks good? If no objections I'll squash+merge at 17:30 PT and watch canary for 30m.

alex: quick look now — looks fine to me, will approve in GH in a minute.

lee: approving now. no blockers from my side.

maya: great — thanks both. I'll merge at 17:30 PT and post a short update in #eng if anything odd shows up during canary.

sam: nice, thanks for taking the follow-ups.

maya: np — ping me here if you spot anything after merge.
